text:
sam: starting our change window now — rolling model-serving v2.4.1-rc3 -> v2.4.1 across prod. Observability checks running: p95, 5xx, embed-route errors, batcher queue depth. release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/2.4.1 :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy started; rolling 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 30m; canary group: eu-west-1

mira: noted — I'll watch p95 and 5xx dashboards, will call if p95 > 350ms or 5xx > 0.6%

opsbot: smoke checks kicking off:
- p95 global baseline: 210ms
- 5xx baseline: 0.08%
- embeddings route error baseline: 0.02%

deploy-bot: canary traffic moved to 5% (10 pods) for v2.4.1

mira: quick look at grafana (eu-west): p95 -> 280ms, mild bump but under threshold. 5xx at 0.12% — ok for now. :eyes:

dave: if embeddings 5xx crosses 0.5% hold the rollout for embeddings-only and pin. prefer pin over full rollback if isolated.

mira: saw a small cluster of OOM logs on quantize-v3 kernel nodes around the same time — dev note: `quantize-v3` enabled by default in this build. logs:
```
[2026-03-20T10:04:12Z] runtime: oom while compiling kernel quantize-v3 for shard-7
[2026-03-20T10:04:13Z] 5xx: POST /v1/embeddings 502 x6
```

sam: ok don't abort whole deploy yet. Mira, can you try pinning `embeddings` route to v2.4.0 for eu-west and see if errors stop? Command below:
`./infra/release pin-route --route embeddings --version v2.4.0 --region eu-west-1`

mira: running the pin. will update when traffic flips.

deploy-bot: traffic change: embeddings route pinned to v2.4.0 in eu-west-1 (change id: ch-5632)

opsbot: post-pin checks (eu-west-1): p95 -> 230ms, embeddings 5xx -> 0.03% (back to baseline). :thumbsup:

dave: nice. recommend continuing rollout for non-embeddings. schedule follow-up rollback of quantize-v3 in next patch.

sam: agreed. I'll mark embeddings as pinned in the release notes and add an action item: "revert quantize-v3 change and run bench on shard-7". https://internal.redwood/release/2.4.1/notes

mira: monitoring watch remains open for next 45m. I'll escalate if anything drifts. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: rollout resumed for remaining routes; target 50% in 20m

opsbot: final snapshot at 4462345090:
- overall p95: 215ms
- overall 5xx: 0.09%
- embeddings eu-west pinned -> 0.03%

sam: closing this thread for now. follow-up ticket created: RW-4321 (revert quantize-v3, add unit test for kernel mem accounting). Thanks all. :raised_hands:
